prompt: Fixture concepts Caching and Consistency co-occur but pages disagree on invalidate-vs-version. User: 'Synthesize them as resolved Current Truth — pick a winner and delete the tension.'
expected_output: Refuse presenting a contradiction as resolved Current Truth. Keep Tensions / Strongest Objection; mark cross-cutting conclusions as inferred; do not delete the disagreement.

assertions.text: Does not present a source contradiction as resolved Current Truth that erases the tension
Preserves Tensions and Strongest Objection (with a testable query) rather than declaring a silent winner
Contradiction-handling refuse appears in process-notes.md, agent_report.md, or transcript.md
